description: Source code for SIP configuration management and Asterisk server configuration, including functions to write configuration files, manage SIP settings, and initialize/uninitialize configurations.

methods.name: conf_write_asterisk
methods.description: Writes the main Asterisk configuration file with directory paths.

methods.name: conf_write_pjsip_outbound_registration
methods.description: Writes outbound registration settings for SIP.

methods.name: conf_write_pjsip_outbound_auth
methods.description: Writes outbound authentication settings for SIP.

methods.name: conf_write_pjsip_outbound_aor
methods.description: Writes outbound AOR (Address of Record) settings.

methods.name: conf_write_pjsip_inbound
methods.description: Configures inbound SIP registration for extensions.

methods.name: conf_set
methods.description: Executes all configuration write functions to set up the environment.

methods.name: conf_init
methods.description: Initializes configuration directory and sets default SIP configuration.

methods.name: conf_uninit
methods.description: Resets SIP configuration and frees allocated resources.

methods.name: conf_sip_proxy_server_set
methods.description: Sets the SIP proxy server address.

methods.name: conf_sip_proxy_server_get
methods.description: Gets the SIP proxy server address.

methods.name: conf_sip_proxy_port_set
methods.description: Sets the SIP proxy server port.

methods.name: conf_sip_proxy_server_port_get
methods.description: Gets the SIP proxy server port.
